headline: V36.1: Strict Planning-First & Zero-Fabrication Design System Governance
highlights: Modular Screen Generation Pipeline: Each screen is rendered to screens/screen_XX.html with dedicated token budget.
Master Self-Healing Assembler: build_design_board.py auto-scaffolds and compiles modular screens into master board.html.
11 Deterministic Validation Gates: Complete CI test suite in run_design_suite.py verifying brief, tokens, states, modularity, and handoff.
Binance Enterprise Design System: High-volume crypto/fintech tokens and component catalog in binance/DESIGN.md.
Planning-First & Zero-Fabrication Governance: Hard refusal to modify code before /develop; strict adherence to local design tokens.
post_update_steps: Run /init_brain after /update_brain to reload rules, MCP registration, skill routing, and V36 command surface.
Run `python3 .agents/scripts/run_design_suite.py --feature <feature-path>` to run all 11 design gates.
onboarding_prompts: Read `V36.1_RELEASE_NOTES.md` for the full overview of the V36.1 Governance & Design OS.
Always clarify requirements before planning: do not invent assumptions if intent, scope, or platform constraints are unclear.
Enforce Planning-First: Never modify code before /develop or without approved spec/plan package.
Enforce 100% Design Token Fidelity: Never invent arbitrary hex codes or tokens outside the project design system.
